subject: SKU unbundling and retention tiers for advanced monitoring add-on
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Velez <elena@stratahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: SKU unbundling and retention tiers for advanced monitoring add-on

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great questions from your platform team. As promised, I wanted to share a compact view of how we price and package our observability add-ons (retention, tracing ingestion, and advanced dashboards) and surface a couple of options that tend to fit health-tech customers like StrataHealth.

High-level options (attached: observability_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx):
- Hourglass retention: 30 / 90 / 365-day buckets with per-GB/month pricing and optional slab discounts for committed volume.
- Tracing ingestion: per-span/ingest unit, with a complementary sample quota and an overage rate.
- Dashboards & seats: base set of 5 dashboards + per-seat licensing for editors.

Two packaging paths I recommend for your usage profile:
1) Predictable commit: 20% list discount at $25k/month commit, plus a one-time migration credit for retained historical traces.
2) Metered with cap: lower commit plus capped monthly egress allowance and a capped overage rate — good if you expect bursty analytics.

Quick ask: could you confirm the approximate monthly TBs of logs/traces you plan to retain and whether the analytics team needs 10–20 concurrent dashboard seats? If you can share a short usage estimate (even a range) we can produce a tailored SKU/discount proposal and a sample SOW.

I attached a sample SOW and the pricing sheet. Looping in Kimberly to outline the concession paths we can offer and Jordan when we get to contracting.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: observability_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample_sow.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: SKU unbundling and retention tiers for advanced monitoring add-on

Hi Priyom — thanks for the overview and the attachments.

A few clarifications from our side:
- Monthly retention estimate: 4–6 TB of logs and ~1.5 TB of traces (ingest) to start; we expect ~25% growth q/q.
- Dashboard seats: initially ~8 editors, expanding to ~15 once we onboard the analytics team.
- Procurement asks: transparent overage math (we get surprised by egress charges), and a clear commitment path that includes a migration credit if we move historical traces into Redwood.

Specific questions:
1) On the commit model, how does the 20% discount scale if we sign for 12 months vs 24 months?
2) For tracing ingestion, do you support tiered sampling at the pipeline level (we want aggressive sampling for low-priority traffic but full fidelity for payment flows)?

Also attached is our security questionnaire; happy to answer anything on our side if you need it.

Best,
Elena Velez
Head of Platform
StrataHealth

Attachments: security_questionnaire.pdf

Hi Elena — nice to meet you over email. I pulled together a concise proposal based on the estimates you shared. See inline pricing and the attached one-page summary (pricing_summary_STR-4812.pdf).

Quick answers to your questions followed by the proposed commercials: 
1) Commit scaling: 12-month commit = 20% off list on add-ons; 24-month commit = 25% off list + 5% accelerator credit applied as monthly bill credit during months 7–12. The accelerator is intended to bridge initial usage variance.
2) Tracing sampling: yes — our pipeline supports policy-based sampling (per-service or per-endpoint). We can guarantee full-fidelity for tagged payment flows and 1–5% sampling for background traffic, which will be configurable at deploy time.

Proposed commercial structure (monthly, USD):
- Retention (logs): $0.48/GB for 30d, $0.20/GB for 90d, $0.055/GB for 365d (list).
- Tracing ingestion: $75 per 100k spans ingest unit; includes 200k sample quota/month.
- Dashboards: $2,500 base / month for core dashboards + $85 per editor seat after 5 seats.

Commit tier concessions (for STR-4812):
- $15k/month commit: 10% discount, no migration credit.
- $25k/month commit: 20% discount + $7,500 one-time migration credit (applies to SOW).
- $45k/month commit: 28% discount + $15k migration credit + waived setup fee.

We can also cap monthly overages for the first 6 months at 10% above forecast if you commit to a 12-month term — helps remove surprise bills.

Next steps: if you like the $25k/month path we can generate a term sheet + SOW and send for signature. I included a DocuSign link in the attachments placeholder; priory next week is doable.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Cloud Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_summary_STR-4812.pdf
